lines.zh: 我背着燃料罐，一步一步巡逻。
lines.en: I patrol step by step with a fuel tank on my back.

lines.zh: 我的靴子压过草地，很沉。
lines.en: My boots press the grass heavily.

lines.zh: 我沿着街道走，扫视两侧。
lines.en: I walk the street, scanning both sides.
I keep the nozzle raised at my chest.

lines.zh: 我朝那栋破房子走过去。
lines.en: I head for that broken house.

lines.zh: 我绕过堆在路口的废料。
lines.en: I go around the wreckage at the crossing.
I keep a few paces behind my squadmate.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边查看墙角。
lines.en: I check the corners as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的面罩里有轻微的白雾。
lines.en: There is faint mist inside my visor.
I follow the blood trail.

lines.zh: 我把脚步放轻，虽然没什么用。
lines.en: I soften my steps, though it hardly helps.
I head toward the screaming.
I hold the nozzle and stand still.
I look around through the visor.
I rest my hand on the valve.

lines.zh: 罐子里有液体晃动的声音。
lines.en: Liquid sloshes in the tank.
I stand still and only listen.
I keep my gaze low.
I raise the nozzle toward the window.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在面罩里回响。
lines.en: My breathing echoes inside the visor.
I wait for the leader's signal.

lines.zh: 我把脚边一块碎石踢开。
lines.en: I kick a loose stone aside.

lines.zh: 我把喷嘴转过来对着你。
lines.en: I swing the nozzle to face you.
State your identity first.

lines.zh: 我面罩下的眼睛在打量你。
lines.en: My eyes study you through the visor.

lines.zh: 你身上有变异的气味吗？
lines.en: Do you carry the smell of mutation?
Your flesh is still whole.
I do not let people pass lightly.

lines.zh: 我把手指从阀门上移开。
lines.en: I move my finger off the valve.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才会放下喷嘴。
lines.en: Step back and only then will I lower the nozzle.
This is a patrol zone.
I do not ask where you came from.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，面罩里起了雾。
lines.en: I give half a step and my visor fogs.

lines.zh: 这一下打在护甲上，闷响。
lines.en: That lands on my armor with a dull thud.
I steady the nozzle.
I grit my teeth and hold my footing.
My shoulder burns.
My breathing has gone rough.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去护住罐子。
lines.en: I turn to shield the tank.
That goes into my log.
My legs still carry me.
I straighten my visor.
I have no appetite for that.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我不为所动。
lines.en: You hold it up and I am unmoved.
Put your hand back.
I take none of that.
If you offer it, set it on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的任务里没有这一项。
lines.en: That is not part of my task.
I shake my head, no.
I go round the outside of your hand.
Keep it for yourself.
I gesture for you to step back.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我倒退了半步。
lines.en: You hit me and I take half a step back.
I bring the nozzle across to block.
My gear is heavy and will not shift.
Do not walk this close to me.
I bar you off with my arm.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，面罩反着光。
lines.en: I look down, my visor catching the light.
I angle aside and yield half a step.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，面罩响了一下。
lines.en: We collide and my visor knocks.
I steady before going on.
Get outside the line.
I am on duty.
Not that.
I turn my visor aside.
The squad does not allow it.
I put my hand back on the valve.
I return to my post.
This is hardly the time.
I raise the nozzle.
I keep watching ahead.
Wait until this wave passes.
I bend and pick up an empty can.
I put it in my belt pouch.
This must not be touched.
I lift it with tongs.
I seal the sample in a bag.
This is of no use.
I put it back for the recovery team.

lines.zh: 我检查了一遍有没有裂。
lines.en: I check it for cracks.
I throw it into the waste bin.
I go on with my patrol.
Something moves behind the wall.
I point the nozzle that way.
I have it on my sight line.
Its movement is wrong.
I open the valve halfway.
I signal my squadmate back.

lines.zh: 我开始靠近，脚步压得很低。
lines.en: I close in with low steps.
It has already mutated.
I watch the joints on it.
I am ready to ignite.
It blocks the crossing.
I hook round by the flank.
I do not shout; shouting would scare it off.

lines.zh: 它就是我们要找的那个。
lines.en: That is the one we came for.
I bring the nozzle to shoulder height.
Begin incineration.

lines.zh: 我跟着它挪，喷嘴一直对着。
lines.en: I shift with it, nozzle always on it.
It circles; I circle, keeping the gap.
I drive it into the corner.
It lunges and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我在等它靠近到燃料的最佳距离。
lines.en: I wait for it to reach the best range.

lines.zh: 我的手一直按在点火上。
lines.en: My hand stays on the igniter.
It falls back and I press in.
My fuel is half left.

lines.zh: 它在喘，可变异体不会累。
lines.en: It is panting, but mutants do not tire.
I lower the nozzle.

lines.zh: 它想从右边跑，我先封住。
lines.en: It tries the right and I block first.
This stretch is a dead end.
The flames flicker on my visor.
I do not let it get close.
I wait one more moment.

lines.zh: 它已经在燃烧的范围内了。
lines.en: It is already inside burning range.
I tighten my grip.
I have this circle shut.

lines.zh: 它每动一次，我就跟一次。
lines.en: Each move of its, I answer.
A fraction closer.
I kick it away.
I strike it with the nozzle's stock.
I shove it off to open the gap.
That lands on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 它抓我，我的防护服挡住了。
lines.en: It claws me and my suit holds.
I add one more punch.
I pin it against the door.
It backs off and I raise the nozzle at once.
My visor is knocked askew.
I keep it outside.

lines.zh: 这一下很近，差点烧到自己。
lines.en: That was close; I nearly burned myself.
I step back and realign.
My breath comes fast.
It is still moving about.
I drive my elbow into its chest.
I slam the nozzle into its face.
I pin its hand under my boot.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，把它推离门口。
lines.en: I ram it and shove it from the door.
It tears my cuff.
I lift a knee and push it off.

lines.zh: 我从街口走进来，喷嘴已经抬起。
lines.en: I come in from the street with the nozzle up.
First I scan this stretch.
I check the fuel valve.
The tank is full.
The smell here is wrong.
I lower my visor against the glare.
I take my stand at the crossing.

lines.zh: 我朝队长那边看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance toward the leader.
I set off forward.
The bricks underfoot are loose.
I signal those behind to follow.
This area has not been burned yet.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到防护服，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame licks my suit and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖一沉，我咬牙撑住。
lines.en: My knees drive down on landing and I hold.

lines.zh: 水从面罩缝里灌进来，我猛抬头。
lines.en: Water seeps through my visor and I jerk my head up.
The blast throws me into the wall.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进护甲，我拔了出来。
lines.en: Something lodges in my armor and I pull it out.

lines.zh: 术式缠住我，我的罐子一沉。
lines.en: An art binds me and my tank feels heavy.

lines.zh: 太久没换班，我的手脚发虚。
lines.en: Too long without relief and my limbs go weak.

lines.zh: 雷顺着装备走，我整条手臂都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning runs my gear and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有砖，我一直坠下去。
lines.en: No brick below and I fall away.
